verdicts.cmd: cd "${WYRD_REPO:-../wyrd}" && { cargo fetch --locked >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 3; } && cargo deny --frozen --all-features --config deny-all-features.toml check advisories >/dev/null 2>&1
verdicts.hint: exited 3: `cargo fetch --locked` failed in ../wyrd (offline, or Cargo.lock out of date with Cargo.toml) — run it there to see why; no advisory was checked. Any other exit: the target's all-features advisory wall (the second cargo-deny step of `cargo xtask ci`) fails on the base, so every bundle's gating C4-ci is red until a separate deny-all-features.toml PR records or clears the advisory (#543; precedent #790/#773; RUSTSEC-2026-0346/0349 landed as 0674f4d). Land it on main, update ../wyrd, then re-run; `cd ../wyrd && cargo deny --all-features --config deny-all-features.toml check advisories` shows the failing ids. Checks ../wyrd as checked out, or $WYRD_REPO
verdicts.detail: detect cmd exited 1 — absent on this host
